paragraphs: MedAttend AI is an end-to-end, high-performance automated attendance and classroom surveillance system designed for large educational auditoriums, medical colleges, and enterprise lecture halls (tested for 300+ students across 6 simultaneous CCTV cameras). It pairs ultra-fast biometric facial recognition (InsightFace ArcFace 512D) with dual-stream RTSP camera pipelines, ONVIF PTZ motor controls, isolated non-blocking WhatsApp parent notification workers, adaptive thermal load balancing, and production auto-recovery watchdogs.
